library.title: Ask for help to use a service
library.intro: Tell an institution what help or adjustment you need to use one of its services: an appointment at an office, an interpreter, another format or someone to help you apply.
library.filled_by: Anyone, or someone helping them; an official at an office.
library.authority: The institution that owns the service or the records (an institution of the registry, or the one the deployment profile names for its slot); never a ministry by name.

values.label: A visit, where the service offers it

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it

The owner is each institution itself for its own services and records: it adopts the front-door and records procedures as its own (svc.<template>.<institution>, rec.<template>.<institution>), drafted by one of its officials and approved by another; a service names its owner as a slot of the deployment profile or an institution of the registry, never a ministry by name
deviations.why: Part 13 §12.3: each institution keeps its own records, service ownership and decisions; the shared platform is no authority over them.
deviations.rule: lib/frontdoor/procedures.ts installFrontdoorProcedures(); lib/recordkeeping/procedures.ts installRecordkeepingProcedures(); lib/frontdoor/catalogue.ts ownerOf()

deviations.what: Every publication, approval and decision is proposed by one official and confirmed by a different person, compared as persons and never only as accounts
deviations.why: Part 13 §7.3 and §15 Gate 3: required dual control prevents self-approval.

deviations.what: No step is decided by a model or a score: officials decide with reasons
deviations.why: Part 13 §11.3: AI must not issue legally consequential decisions.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model (AI never makes a legally material decision)
